Description: FloSports is a world-class sports media company strategically positioned to be the essential destination for passionate sports fans, delighting them with live event coverage, breaking news, highlights, stats, rankings, and team and player profiles. We are growing Our Sports every day by continuing to invest in our ever-expanding ecosystem, which consists of over a dozen sport verticals and hundreds of streaming partners. FloSports is creating the home for college conferences/leagues and sports like grappling, hockey, track & field, racing, cheer, wrestling, and more, and we are looking for innovative and passionate people like you to help us! THE ROLE: FloSports is looking for a Social Media Designer to help elevate how our sports, athletes, events, and stories show up across social and digital platforms. This role sits within the Creative team and works as a dedicated partner to the Content organization. Creative will provide brand direction, design standards, mentorship, and the overall visual vision, while the Content team will manage day-to-day priorities and workload. This isn’t just a production design role. We’re looking for someone who understands social media, sports culture, and what makes people stop scrolling. You’ll create daily social assets, develop repeatable tools and templates for content teams, and help evolve how the FloSports brand comes to life across our different sports. RESPONSIBILITIES: Create high-quality, social-first graphics for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, Facebook, and emerging platforms. Design thumbnails, breaking-news graphics, athlete and event storytelling, stats, rankings, results, promotional content, and other day-to-day social assets. Partner closely with Content teams to quickly turn stories, moments, and ideas into compelling visual content. Build scalable templates, toolkits, and design systems that allow Content teams to create more efficiently while staying on brand. Own and evolve the visual approach for recurring content formats across multiple FloSports verticals. Translate FloSports brand standards into practical solutions that work within the speed and demands of social media. Maintain consistency in typography, color, logo usage, composition, and overall visual quality across Content-created assets. Identify opportunities to improve existing social formats rather than simply continuing to use legacy templates. Experiment with new visual styles, formats, motion, AI tools, and emerging creative techniques that can improve the quality and speed of social content. Collaborate with designers, editors, producers, social leads, and other content creators across FloSports. Balance speed with craft, knowing when something needs to ship quickly and when a larger moment deserves a more elevated creative approach. Stay current on sports culture, social design trends, platform behaviors, and how leading sports and media brands are evolving their content. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES: A strong portfolio demonstrating social-first design, visual storytelling, typography, composition, and brand thinking. Experience designing for social media, digital content, sports, entertainment, media, or a similarly fast-paced environment. Strong Photoshop and Illustrator skills. Experience with After Effects, Premiere, Figma, or other motion/content creation tools is a major plus. A strong understanding of what makes creative effective across different social platforms. Ability to work quickly and manage multiple requests without sacrificing attention to detail. Comfortable working within an established brand system while knowing when and how to push it forward. Strong collaborator who can take direction from Creative while working closely with Content stakeholders every day. Comfortable creating both one-off, high-impact pieces and scalable systems that other creators can use. Interest in sports and an understanding of fan culture is strongly preferred. BONUS: You’ll be part of the FloSports Creative team, but your primary partner will be Content. Content owns the need. Creative owns the standard. You help connect the two. The Content team will guide daily priorities, stories, and deliverables. The Creative team will provide design leadership, brand direction, feedback, and professional development. The goal is to give Content a dedicated creative partner who understands their speed and needs while ensuring everything we produce continues to feel unmistakably FloSports. Some work may occur on select nights and weekends. OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY: At FloSports, we are bonded by our passion for sports and our purpose to unite communities around experiences that finally give underserved sports the love they deserve. We recognize the need to build a company that seeks out, embraces, and celebrates our individual differences, ideas, and talent. FloSports is committed to the pursuit of a fair, equal and inclusive workplace where everyone is given the opportunity to grow to their fullest potential. OUR BENEFITS: Recognized three years in a row as a Top Workplace by the Austin-American Statesman Flexibility at work - you can take control of your profession and personal schedule All-hands events hosted in beautiful Austin, Texas Annual equity awards for all top performers Competitive and comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans Peace of mind through company-paid short-term disability, long-term disability and life insurance Generous 401(K) company match vested immediately Progressive parental leave policies Flexible paid time off Hack-a-thons and a full calendar of team-building and social events Company donation to youth teams and leagues that our employees coach Stocked snack bar, catered lunch and breakfast tacos every week

Description:
The Company

Sendbird is on a mission to build the AI workforce of tomorrow. For over a decade, we built the infrastructure behind conversations—chat, voice, video, messaging APIs—and became the #1 CPaaS platform for in-app communications. 4,000+ brands trust us. 7 billion messages flow through our platform every month. 300 million monthly active users.
We powered conversations for DoorDash, Match Group, Noom, Yahoo Sports, Rakuten, and thousands of others. We were good at what we did. Really good.
We also saw it early: AI would fundamentally reshape how businesses talk to customers. The infrastructure we'd spent a decade building would become commoditized. The value would move up the stack—into intelligence, into experience, into outcomes.
We had a choice: protect what we built, or reinvent ourselves.
We chose reinvention.
In December 2024, we made the full strategic pivot to AI-first customer experience. By February 2025, we'd launched our AI agent for enterprise CX—built on a decade of conversation data, now with intelligence on top. And in November 2025, we rebranded to delight.ai.
The name says it all. AI's real promise isn't efficiency or cost savings. It's giving customers back something they lost—the feeling of being truly understood and cared for. Not satisfied. Delighted

The Product

Delight.ai is the AI concierge for customer experience. Most AI agents forget you the moment the conversation ends. Ours doesn't. Delight.ai builds memory over time, learns preferences, and connects context across every channel without losing the thread. We're building AI that makes customers feel understood, seen, and remembered.

The Role

The Technical Writing team at Sendbird empowers developers to build successful businesses on our platform by delivering high-quality content — from documentation and user guides to tutorials, UI text, and beyond. As a Technical/UX Writer, you'll be at the center of the developer experience, transforming complex technical concepts into content that is clear, concise, and actionable.

You might be this person if

  • You quickly spot friction in the user experience — whether it's a confusing UI label, unclear documentation, or a workflow that loses developers halfway through — and you can articulate exactly what's wrong and why.
  • You're a critical thinker who questions the obvious and finds a better path when the conventional one doesn't work.
  • You're genuinely curious about AI — not just as a trend, but as a tool you actively use to work faster and smarter. Sendbird encourages all members to tap into the most advanced tools available.
  • You thrive in cross-functional work. You'll collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and UX designers to create content that meets real customer needs.
  • You take ownership. You don't wait to be told what needs fixing — you spot it, flag it, and drive it forward.
  • You're not afraid to ask questions. When you need context, resources, or a second opinion, you seek them out — proactively and without hesitation.

What you'll actually do

  • Create content: Develop and maintain high-quality documentation, user guides, and UI text strings for Sendbird's products, ensuring clarity and accuracy.
  • Write UX copy: Craft button labels, error messages, onboarding flows, and tooltips that guide users with minimal friction.
  • Improve content: Build an effective feedback loop and integrate customer insights into our content.
  • Work with AI: Use AI tools actively in your writing workflow — to draft, restructure, automate, and iterate — while applying your own judgment to every output.
  • Stay current: Research competitor products, B2B trends, and developer communities to keep our content competitive and relevant.

You need to have

  • Experience: 0–2 years in technical writing, UX writing, content design, or a related field.
  • Content writing sense: You notice when content does not deliver its message effectively  — and you can explain why. This is foundational to how we work.
  • AI proficiency: You've used AI tools in real writing or content work. You know how to direct them with purpose, and you treat their output as a first draft.
  • Writing and communication: Fluent in English and Korean, both written and verbal.
  • Collaborative tools: Familiar with Git, GitBook, Confluence, Jira, Figma, or similar tools.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Contract Period : 6month

 Added value

  • Background in Computer Science, Technical Writing, or a related field.
  • Experience with AI or SaaS product development.
  • Familiarity with API, SDK, or any programming languages such as Swift, Kotlin, or JavaScript.

 

Our KR benefits include (but are not limited to)

  • Be Your Best Self: 3.9 million won (prorated by start date) for expenses ranging from professional development classes and training, to personality assessments, to gym memberships, to books, to fitness classes, to mental health services, to massages
  • Annual cash-equivalent special welfare points of 200,000 KRW for Seollal and Chuseok holidays each
  • Learn a Language benefit - up to 3.6 million won per year towards language lessons 
  • Weekly team lunch
  • Monthly team building cost
  • Partial support for commuting costs
  • Free parking at the Seolleung office
  • Group insurance support that covers employees, spouses, and children
  • Medical checkup support, including MRI and genetic testing - for the employee and one family member
  • Seven additional paid holidays in addition to annual leave (Boost leave, Birthday leave, etc.)
  • Support for the latest work devices, such as MacBook Pro (special support options for each job position)
  • Unlimited snack bar filled with snacks, beverages, and instant noodles every day
  • 12-week paid parental leave support (available for both mothers and fathers)
  • Other support programs for congratulations and condolences

 

Flexible Work Policy

We offer a flexible work schedule at Sendbird.  We also value collaboration and relationship building.  With those values in mind, we require all employees to gather with their team in the office three days per week as a minimum.  Some of our roles require a more frequent in-office schedule.  Please work with your manager to understand the office time requirements for your position.

What diversity and inclusion mean to us

There is no such thing as a perfect candidate and the best employees come from a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and skill sets. Sendbird is a place where everyone can learn and grow. We respect, promote, and encourage diversity for equal employment opportunities and encourage you to apply if this role excites you.

Why Sendbird

We spent a decade building the conversation infrastructure that the world runs on. Now we're putting intelligence on top of it. You won't be joining a company still figuring out its AI strategy. You'll be joining one that has already made the bet, shipped the product, and is moving fast to lead the category. If you want to build something that matters, with a team that knows how, this is it.

Description:
Company Overview   

Amperesand is reinventing how the world powers its most critical systems.

We are facing a once-in-a-generation opportunity for infrastructure disruption. Electricity demand is skyrocketing, driven by AI factories, electric vehicles, and modern industrial growth. Energy supply is shifting to incorporate a more diverse mix of resources – including solar, gas, and batteries – at a massive scale.

And yet the power infrastructure behind our latest mega-projects hasn’t meaningfully changed in nearly 100 years. Supply chains for today’s infrastructure equipment can’t match the pace and sophistication of critical energy projects. Amperesand is building hardware and software that rewrites this broken power infrastructure playbook to support a new era of energy abundance.

We’ve built a new class of intelligent, software-defined power infrastructure products leveraging a decade of advanced medium voltage Solid State Transformer research that’s now ready for commercial deployment.

Our products and solutions go far beyond the capabilities of traditional electrical equipment. We make power systems that are faster to deploy, dramatically smaller and more efficient, and capable of supporting modern, dynamic energy needs for tomorrow’s most demanding energy consumers.

Scalable in-house advanced manufacturing capability is our foundation for meeting timeline and quality expectation to serve infrastructure customers around the world.

Amperesand is led by breakthrough energy hardware development veterans and funded by top tier investors who share our vision of building a category-defining energy technology company.

With hubs in San Francisco, Reno, and Singapore, our global team is laser focused on building foundational technology to solve the most pressing problems in power infrastructure at scale.

Join us in building the power foundation of the future!

About Amperesand

Amperesand is building next-generation power infrastructure systems for Data Centers, EV charging platforms, and future energy applications. Our systems combine advanced power electronics, embedded controls, and scalable energy architectures to rethink how power is converted, controlled, and deployed.

About the Role

Amperesand is seeking an experienced Technical Writer to join the Deployment team to lead the development and management of comprehensive product documentation and to develop an online document portal for our customers and partners. This role is central to our commitment to delivering clear, accurate, and compliant documentation across the entire product lifecycle from customer acquisision through site design, installation, commissioning, operations, service, and safety. This role will support the entire commercial organization across Sales, Deployment, Service, and Policy. We’re looking for candidates that are skilled communicators, technical subject-matter translators, and have experience with online portal administration. We’re seeking an individual who can work effectively across engineering, product, IT and other partner teams. You will author manuals that meet rigorous industry standards, establish documentation best practices, and build a world-class portal experience that empowers customers and partners to find and use our technical resources independently.

What You’ll Do

  • Author, edit, and maintain the full suite of product documentation including sales content, site design guides, installation manuals, commissioning procedures, operations and maintenance manuals, service and troubleshooting guides, safety documentation, applications notes and technical whitepapers.
  • Translate complex electrical, mechanical, and control-system information into clear, accurate, and standardized documentation with support from internal teams.
  • Manage source files, graphics, diagrams, and illustrations, coordinating with engineering and design resources to keep visuals current and technically accurate.
  • Develop and enforce documentation standards, templates, and style guides to ensure consistency, accuracy, and compliance across all manuals and technical publications.
  • Plan, manage, and prioritize documentation projects against product development and release schedules, coordinating revisions for new products, engineering changes, and field updates.
  • Design, implement, and administer an online document portal, including site structure, content organization, and access permissions.
  • Monitor portal usage and gather customer/partner feedback to continuously improve document findability, clarity, and the overall self-service support experience.
  • Lead translation and localization efforts for international markets, ensuring technical accuracy is preserved across languages.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of technical writing experience for technologically complex products involving hardware and software.
  • Demonstrated experience authoring installation, commissioning, operations, service, and safety documentation for complex mechanical or electrical equipment.
  • Sufficient technical depth to easily grasp technical concepts across engineering domains including mechanical, electrical, controls, software, networking.
  • Proven experience planning, building, or administering a document management system or customer/partner portal, including configuring user roles.
  • Proficiency with technical publishing and authoring tools (e.g., Adobe FrameMaker, MadCap Flare, Oxygen XML, or similar structured authoring/DITA environments) and graphics tools (e.g., Adobe Illustrator/Photoshop, draw.io, Blender, etc).
  • Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple documentation projects and deadlines simultaneously across cross-functional teams.
  • Strong written communication skills with meticulous attention to accuracy, consistency, and clarity in highly technical subject matter.
  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally to manufacturing, installation, or job sites to gather firsthand technical information.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in a startup.
  • Experience working as an engineer.
  • Strong preference for candidates from energy, power generation, industrial equipment, or equipment OEM environments.
  • Ability to independently interpret electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, mechanical drawings, CAD models, engineering specifications, and test documentation for translation into customer/partner documentation.

Description: About Hevo: Hevo is a no-code Data Pipeline platform trusted by 1,000+ companies globally, including Postman, Shopify, Doordash and Gartner. Backed by $42M from Peak XV Partners and Chiratae Ventures, we power the data infrastructure of companies that move fast. We are consistently rated #1 on G2 in the ETL and Data Integration category (4.5+ rating) and are a Snowflake Premier Partner. Our product is in the market, loved by customers, and now entering its next growth phase. With 600+ US customers already on the platform and a product that has matured significantly over the last two years, this is the ground-floor moment. Before the team scales, before the brand becomes obvious. The upside is real and uncapped. About the Role: We're looking for an Associate Technical Writer who's comfortable working in a docs-as-code environment and can partner with AI tools (e.g., Claude) for all aspects of the work — not just writing, but operating within an automated documentation pipeline. This is an opportunity to own documentation end-to-end within a modern, AI-assisted workflow, working closely with engineering, product, and support stakeholders to keep a shared source of truth accurate and consistent. What You'll Do: Create and maintain user documentation using a docs-as-code workflow — Markdown/YAML source files, Git-based version control, and CI-driven publishing (e.g., Jekyll). Independently own small documentation tickets and projects end-to-end, from research through PR merge. Use AI-assisted tools (Claude or equivalent) to draft, summarize, restructure, or QA content, while critically reviewing and editing AI output rather than publishing it as-is. Conduct research and gather technical information from product specs, engineering discussions, and existing docs to fill knowledge gaps. Follow and help enforce documentation standards, style guides, and metadata conventions (e.g., structured fields for error messages, FHS-style rule sets) across a shared source of truth. Work in Git-based workflows: branching, raising PRs, responding to review comments, and triggering automation for doc builds/publishing. Collaborate with engineering, product, and support stakeholders to validate technical accuracy before publishing. Flag ambiguous, unverified, or inferred content rather than publishing unconfirmed information. What We're Looking For: Strong written English and ability to simplify technical concepts for end users. Basic familiarity with Markdown, Git (clone/branch/commit/PR), and a willingness to use docs-as-code tooling. Comfort using AI writing/review tools as part of a daily workflow (prompting, verifying, editing output), including the ability to create and manage Claude skills. Ability to read and interpret product UI, API docs, or basic YAML/JSON structures well enough to document them. Detail-oriented, especially around consistency (terminology, tone, formatting) across a large, distributed content set. 0-2 years of experience in technical writing, content, or a related field; internships or academic writing experience acceptable. Bonus Points: Exposure to a ticketing/PM tool (Jira, Confluence) and Slack-based collaboration. Intermediate AI skills creation.
